Annihilape

Fighting Ghost

Paldea · Generation 9

Annihilape is a Fighting/Ghost-type Rage Monkey Pokémon first found in Paldea (Generation 9). It stands 1.2 m tall and weighs 56 kg. It evolves from Primeape. Its highest base stat is Attack (115), with a base stat total of 535.
